text:
tiger: quick thread to lock follow-ups from the recent KV-leak postmortem. want clear owners + measurable checkpoints.
noemi: i can own the allocation-profiling work and the flamegraph exports. ETA first run in 3 days.
ravi: i'll take the shard-level soft limits + routing fallback ticket. will prototype fallback logic that moves traffic off heavy shards.
sre-ops: note: remember to include a safety circuit in the fallback so we don't cascade to other nodes.
noemi: profiler notes pasted below, small example of the hot path we saw:
noemi: ```
# top hotspots from pprof
0.42s  26.5%  alloc_kv_block
0.28s  17.7%  kv_insert_path
0.16s  10.1%  update_refcount
```
tiger: good. we'll need structured traces for each canary run. noemi pls push artifacts to the frag-bucket and tag with canary-YYYYMMDD.
noemi: will do. also adding a cheap gc-invocation test: force compact after N writes and measure frag_ratio delta.
ravi: sketch for fallback rule:
- soft_limit_pct = 78
- hard_limit_pct = 94
- on_soft_limit: mark shard degraded, start async compaction, route new sessions to spare pool with 50% throttle
- on_hard_limit: background drain and refuse new writes
ravi: i'll open RED-4007 and include tests + rollback plan.
sre-ops: FYI infra-bot is tracking a repeating pattern; linking incidents: INC-4680, INC-4709
infra-bot: recurring-pattern-detected: KV growth spikes precede OOM by median 7.5 minutes across affected clusters. see: https://monitoring.redwood/oom-patterns
tiger: owners summary: noemi=profiling+canary artifact, ravi=limits+routing+RED-4007, sre-ops=dashboard+alerts. i'll coordinate cross-team reviews and write the follow-up PR template.
noemi: small canary plan: deploy gc_low=0.45 on 3 nodes in canary, run synthetic burst for 6 hours, collect perf + trace + frag_ratio every 5m.
ravi: will add a canary policy to the router so we can isolate traffic. ETA to have policy ready: 2 days.
sre-ops: i'll build a dashboard panel showing frag_ratio, kv_alloc/s, p95 latency, and percent of soft-evict events. targeting Fri for prototype.
tiger: timeline check: profiling runs start Wed, canary by Fri, decision meeting next Tue. everyone ok?
noemi: ok for me.
ravi: ok.
sre-ops: ok.
tiger: final asks: 1) add your rows and ETAs to the frag-ledger doc; 2) add links to tickets and canary artifacts; 3) drop a 1-line weekly status in the sheet before the decision meeting. will close this thread once ledger updated. :white_check_mark:
filename_note: KV leak postmortem follow-up owners and checkpoints
